verdict.rationale: Stripe's refund docs state you can "refund all or part of a payment after it succeeds" and that refunds can be issued "by using the Refunds API or the Dashboard", with refunded payments viewable in the Dashboard. Payment Links also list no-code refunds, and the MCP server supports refund creation behind human confirmation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the refund workflow, in-depth detail on the Dashboard partial-refund flow (only one-line doc snippets are present).
